about_the_game:
Darkness invades the world, and the light of the entire continent is devoured. Somewhere in the world, the last magical lighthouse shines its final light. Guard it, for it is the last hope of this world!

Meow Tower - Doomsguard is a game rich in roguelike elements. The instant changes and strategies during battles will determine whether you win or lose. It is a strategic RPG game that combines the random elements of Roguelite. You will play as a guardian, defending the lighthouse from the attacks of the monster army.

During the preparation phase, you need to carefully consider how to build and upgrade the lighthouse, as well as arm and guide various heroes. When it comes to the defense phase, you need to use your wisdom and a variety of hero items to repel the enemies surging from all directions. Strengthen your heroes through battles, and make timely and necessary recoveries until you defeat the BOSS and successfully survive to a new day.

Classic Strategic RPG:
● Classic RPG elements: stats, skills, talents, attribute weaknesses... and all the other elements you desire.
● Abundant equipment and heroes: armor, weapons, accessories, in-game items... In addition to stats and skills, equipment will also come with random affixes. Each hero has its own unique skill set and combat characteristics.
● A highly free growth system. Skillfully combine talents and equipment, and boldly form your own unique hero team.
● A unique in-game combat experience. You need to consider which hero to upgrade first and equip with artifacts to allow it to advance preferentially. One advancement will unlock a new skill, and two advancements will unlock an extremely powerful ultimate skill. Each hero has its own characteristics, and it is extremely important to determine your upgrade strategy according to different waves of monsters.

Confronting the Monster Army:
● The number of enemies far exceeds that of our side. As a guardian, you need to formulate the best tactics, use AOE skills to cause damage, apply crowd control, and defeat enemies one by one... Every decision may be the key to turning the tide of the battle.
● When facing a wide variety of monster combinations, it is crucial to make good use of the restraint relationships and hero characteristics. Please be extremely careful when dealing with the elite enemies that appear on the battlefield!
● During the blood moon that appears every day, there will be a carefully designed and highly challenging BOSS. Please defeat it, as you can obtain powerful blessings that will help us better survive each day in the future.

Developing and Protecting the Lighthouse:
● Reasonably use resources to rebuild the lighthouse, and strengthen your combat power by means such as preparing for battles, purchasing equipment, recruiting heroes, and challenging talents.
● You will obtain resources once every day. Whether you use these limited resources to fully develop technology, expand the economy, focus on forging items, or build defenses will all affect the difficulty of survival.
● Protect the magical crystal at the top of the tower at all costs! Once it shatters, darkness will descend.
● In total, you need to defend for 30 days. There will be a blood moon every 5 days, and how long you can survive depends entirely on the decisions of the guardian.

Roguelite Random Elements:
● The game is quite challenging, and you may often encounter situations where the crystal shatters. However, every attempt you make will make you stronger, faster, and more powerful.
● Randomly generated heroes, enemies, weapons, and equipment will bring you long-lasting and new fun.
● The talent system allows you to make some unique configuration points outside of battles, so that you can better face challenges.
● After battles, if certain conditions are met, some new heroes will join, giving you a brand-new experience in the next game.
● For super hardcore players who want to challenge themselves, nightmare and hell difficulties will be unlocked after clearing the game.

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 2000 / XP / Vista / 7 / 8 / 10
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or higher
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Open GL compliant video card
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
